public_logic_basis: Asian-session XAUUSD range frozen before London trading window
persistence or causal retest confirmation before entry

C01_PERSIST.rule: first S5 close outside frozen Asian range; next completed S5 close must remain outside; execute first tick at/after second bar right edge

C02_RETEST.rule: first S5 close outside range; within next 6 completed S5 bars price must touch boundary and close back outside in breakout direction; execute first tick at/after retest bar right edge

selection_rule: advance only a preregistered profile that passes all supply/economic gates; if multiple strong-pass, rank by direct net then wins without retuning
citations_note: Logic reconstructed from current MetaQuotes/MQL5 ORB and Asian-range breakout descriptions plus open-source TradingView ORB descriptions; external profitability claims are not treated as evidence.
